style: Approved Premier League pixel art; country-specific stadium scenery for season progress

leagues.theme: sunny Mediterranean modern football ground with cream stucco and warm sandstone stadium exteriors, terracotta tiled city rooftops, a few slender palms, distant dry green hills, golden afternoon light and soft pale azure clouds. Warm ochre and muted red seats.

French city football ground with refined pale-stone facades, slate mansard rooftops and chimney stacks beyond the stands, plane trees, modern graceful curved steel stadium roofs, soft blue-gray afternoon sky with a warm sun break. Muted blue and white stands; no dominant famous monument.

German urban football ground, bold modern white concrete and gray steel cantilever roofs, brick apartment blocks with steep roofs, forested hills, broad deciduous trees, cool partly cloudy northern European afternoon; muted red and gray-blue stadium seats. Distinct modern industrial structural geometry.

Portuguese football ground with whitewashed buildings and yellow trim, terracotta tiled roofs, a small tasteful blue-and-white tile pattern on a stadium side wall, gentle coastal hills, a few palms, warm Atlantic afternoon light; muted green and red seating.

Italian football ground with pale concrete oval grandstands and shallow curved roofs, cream historic apartment facades with warm terracotta tiled roofs, elegant umbrella pine silhouettes and distant rolling hills. Gentle warm late-afternoon light, muted blue and red seats.

Dutch football ground with low modern transparent-edge roofed stands, brick stepped-gable town houses beyond the stadium, flat green surroundings, a small narrow canal-side skyline far behind, cool maritime clouds and soft sunlight. Muted orange and navy seats; no giant windmill inside the field.

Belgian city football ground with compact roofed stands, brick and cream-stone Flemish stepped-gable buildings beyond the stadium, dark slate roofs, a small historic town-hall tower in the far distance, lush broadleaf trees and soft overcast daylight. Muted burgundy and cream stadium seating.

Argentine compact urban football ground with steep close rectangular terraces, vivid sky-blue and cream seating plus small colorful banners without words, concrete city apartment blocks and plane trees beyond the stands. Bright blue temperate afternoon sky with soft clouds; passionate cozy neighborhood ground, no European terraced houses.

Brazilian urban football stadium with airy open curved concrete stands, warm colorful stucco apartment facades beyond the terraces, lush tropical hills, palms, luminous tropical clouds and sunshine. Soft yellow, green and blue seating. Bright inviting professional football setting, no dominant famous monument.

Norwegian small professional football ground with modest roofed stands, Nordic red wooden houses and pale modern buildings beyond the stadium, dense spruce forest and distant cool mountains overlooking a suggestion of fjord. Crisp soft northern afternoon sunlight, pale blue-gray clouds and muted blue seats.

South Korean modern football stadium with clean angular cream tensile cantilever roofs, orderly apartment towers and a few midrise buildings beyond the stands, a lush Korean mountain ridge, soft warm-clear afternoon clouds. Muted red and blue seating. Modern urban Korean football setting, no traditional palace replacing the stadium.

Japanese compact football stadium with clean geometric lightweight roofed stands, orderly low-rise town buildings with gray tiled roofs and modern apartments beyond, soft green mountain ridge and a small cherry tree at an outer corner. Clear gentle blue spring-afternoon sky, tidy blue and cream seating. Modern cozy Japanese football ground, not a temple theme park.

American modern soccer-specific stadium with broad elegant rounded roof canopies, clean steel and glass edges, a few contemporary midrise city buildings and oaks beyond the stands. Airy sunny blue afternoon with large soft white clouds; navy and muted red seating. Only association football pitch lines, no American football markings.

Nigerian modern urban professional football stadium with warm cream concrete roofed stands, a few ochre and terracotta apartment blocks and modern buildings beyond, tall palms and broad lush tropical trees, warm humid golden daylight and cream clouds. Green, blue and cream seating. Welcoming well-kept modern stadium, no rural huts or desert stereotypes.
